semiconductor_relevance: High — ESPEC provides specialized testing equipment that addresses critical thermal and electrical evaluation needs for next-generation semiconductors.
summary: ESPEC develops advanced testing equipment solutions tailored for the semiconductor industry, focusing on thermal and environmental stress testing. Their systems are designed to evaluate the reliability of power semiconductors, particularly those utilizing silicon carbide (SiC) technology, under various conditions.
capabilities: Electro-chemical Migration Evaluation System for insulation degradation testing
Power Cycle Test System for SiC/IGBT reliability evaluation
Real-time monitoring of environmental test chambers
